title: Vperk - Immortal Global Perks
body:
Syntax: vperk list
        vperk status
        vperk <perk> on|off
        vperk on|off <perk>

Description: Immortals can activate or disable a perk across the ENTIRE MUD for 24 hours. Every village and every character receives the same global EXP, damage, or Ryo boost. No mission points are spent. A global perk survives server reboots and crashes. Enabling again refreshes 24 hours; disabling removes only that global perk. One global perk per category may be active; changing double EXP to triple EXP replaces the old global EXP boost. Kage-purchased bonuses are still restricted to their own villages, remain separate, and last one hour.

Examples:
  vperk list
  vperk status
  vperk double exp on
  vperk double exp off
  vperk triple damage on
  vperk double ryo on

Perks: double exp, triple exp, double damage, triple damage, double ryo, triple ryo.

Date: 2026-10-24
